description:
Use this when the user asks what FIIs and DIIs have been buying or selling in Indian equities day by day across the whole market. Not for a company's ownership percentage; use get_shareholding.

Returns one row per trading day with FII and DII buy, sell and net values in Rs crore for the NSE cash segment. `from_date` and `to_date` are ISO dates; the default is the last 30 days and the longest window is 366 days. For F&O positions by participant use get_fo_participant_activity; for one sector, get_sector_fpi_investment.
name: get_market_fii_dii_flow
title: FII and DII market flow
